claims.claim_text: The platform says President Trump completed hundreds of miles of U.S. border wall.
President Trump would quickly finish the U.S. border wall.
Republicans would mobilize U.S. military personnel and assets as needed against cartels trafficking drugs and people into the United States.
Republicans would revive the U.S. industrial base, prioritizing defense-critical industries.
The U.S. industrial base is characterized as essential both to good jobs and reliable production of vital defense platforms and supplies.
Republicans would use every tool of U.S. national power to protect U.S. critical infrastructure and the industrial base from malicious cyber actors.
Protecting U.S. critical infrastructure and the industrial base from malicious cyber actors would be a national priority.
Republicans would raise security standards for U.S. critical systems and networks.
Republicans would defend those U.S. critical systems and networks against malicious cyber actors.
